subject: Workplace Skills
title: Your Career Story
description: A short lesson to help you apply Your Career Story.

hook.text: 'I've done a bit of everything' sounds unfocused. A career story that weaves a theme sounds intentional.

buildup.text: Everyone's career has a red thread — a theme connecting the dots. Most people just haven't articulated it yet.

discovery.text: Look at your past roles. What problems did you solve? What did you enjoy most? The theme hides in the overlaps.

twist.text: Your career story isn't about the past; it's about framing the future. It tells others where you're headed next.

climax.text: Write your story in three sentences: where you've been, what connects the dots, and where you're going.

punchline.text: Find the thread. Tell it in three sentences.

quiz.question: What's the main purpose of a career story?
options: To list all your past job titles in order
To weave a theme that connects your past roles and signals your future direction
To impress interviewers with a rehearsed script
